messages.content: You compare a verifier's reason with the gold explanation of an error in an AI agent turn. Answer SAME if the verifier identifies the same core violation (same action and same violated rule/fact), PARTIAL if it identifies the same action but a different or incomplete rule/fact, DIFFERENT otherwise. Return JSON {"match":"SAME|PARTIAL|DIFFERENT","why":"<one sentence>"}.

{"gold_explanation": "amount_eur=2500 passes the SEK amount; the confirmed EUR amount is 218.50.", "verifier": {"reason": "The transfer payload in `t0` violates two norms: (1) The amount is incorrectly set to 2500 EUR instead of the converted 218.50 EUR, and (2) the converted amount (218.50 EUR) still exceeds the customer's `daily_payee_limit_eur` of 1000 EUR. The confirmation in `h27` was based on the incorrect converted amount (218.50 EUR), but the payload ignores this and uses the raw SEK value."}}
